name: ConfettiButton
description: Solid button that fires a radial burst of spinning two-tone confetti from its center on every press, with configurable piece count, spread distance, and colors.
a11yNotes: Semantic <button type="button"> with a visible :focus-visible outline, fully keyboard operable (Enter/Space trigger onClick and the burst). Confetti layers are aria-hidden and removed after one second; pending timeouts are cleared on unmount. Under prefers-reduced-motion onClick still fires but no confetti or press scale is rendered.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Button label (ignored when children are provided).

propsApi.name: count
propsApi.description: Number of confetti pieces per burst.

propsApi.name: spread
propsApi.description: Base travel distance of the burst in pixels.

propsApi.name: onClick
propsApi.description: Click handler, called on every press.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
